Class MimeMail<T extends Mime>

java.lang.Object
gate.type.mime.MimeMail<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the root MIME type of the message content
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class MimeMail<T extends Mime> extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable mail message model used by Gate messaging.

A MimeMail contains a subject, a priority, a MIME content tree and optional mail headers. Header names are normalized to lowercase and repeated headers accumulate values under the same key.
